Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task d972feef — fill framed cavities by interior size

Verified solved on the test with 0 wrong submissions after 2 demo requests.

## Rule
Find closed, axis-aligned rectangular frames (including 3x3 rings) in an otherwise uniform background. Preserve every frame pixel and all exterior/background cells. Fill only the enclosed interior with a color determined by the interior dimensions/area:
- A 1x1 interior (3x3 frame) -> color 7.
- A 3x3 interior (5x5 frame) -> color 7.
- A 4x4 interior (6x6 frame) -> color 2.
The demos and accepted test indicate this mapping across differing frame colors; do not use the outline color to choose the fill. For the demonstrated sizes, it appears the output denotes the cavity class/size (small cavity -> 7; larger 4x4 cavity -> 2). If a future instance has a different cavity size, seek a demo rather than extrapolating beyond the evidence.

## Demo evidence
- Demo 1: 3x3 frame color 4 with center background 8 -> center 7. A 6x6 frame color 9 enclosing 4x4 cells -> fill 2. A 4x4 frame color 0 enclosing 2x2 cells -> fill 2 (additional evidence that exact area/dimension interpretation may have more detail than the sparse mapping above; observe full demos carefully).
- Demo 2: 5x5 frames of colors 9 and 8, each enclosing 3x3 -> fill 7. A 6x6 frame color 8 enclosing 4x4 -> fill 2. 3x3 frames of colors 3 and 5 with a single enclosed cell -> fill 7.
- Accepted test: 5x5 color-1 frame (3x3 interior) -> 7; 3x3 color-0 frame (single cell) -> 7; 3x3 color-6 frames (single interior cell, including two distinct frames) -> 7; 3x3 color-5 frame -> 7.

Note the demo-1 4x4 frame with a 2x2 cavity filled as 2, despite the 3x3 frame's 1x1 cavity being 7: likely size thresholds/area classes rather than the exact dimensions listed above. The unequivocal pattern is small single-cell and 3x3 interiors -> 7; 2x2 and 4x4 interiors -> 2. Preserve the surrounding grid and fill only cavities.
